CheckTitle: PostgreSQL Flexible Server audit logs are enabled
Description: Verify that PostgreSQL audit logging is enabled.
Risk: Missing audit logs impede tracking of database access and modifications.

Code.CLI:
az postgres flexible-server parameter set -g <resource-group> -s <server-name> -n shared_preload_libraries -v pgaudit
az postgres flexible-server parameter set -g <resource-group> -s <server-name> -n pgaudit.log -v 'WRITE,DDL'
Code.Other:
1. Update 'shared_preload_libraries' to include 'pgaudit' (preserve any existing libraries separated by commas). Note: Updating shared_preload_libraries requires a server restart.
2. Restart the PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
3. Configure 'pgaudit.log' parameter with the desired audit events (e.g., 'WRITE, DDL, ROLE, FUNCTION').

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Postgresql Flexible Server Audit Logs Enabled.
